quotes.text: Behind every plate is a farmer, a cook and a morning that began before yours. A moment of thanks costs nothing.
Food is one of the few daily pleasures that is also good for you. Enjoy it on purpose.
Before the first bite, take a breath and notice that you have food. Not everyone does today.
Gratitude changes the flavour of a very ordinary meal.
A warm plate and a full glass of water are small luxuries we forget to call luxuries.
Thank the person who cooked. Thank yourself if it was you.
It took sun, soil, rain and a great many hands to bring this to you.
The simplest meals, eaten with thanks, tend to taste like enough.
Enjoy the meal you have, not the one you are planning.
There is joy in a well-made chai, a crisp apple, a warm roti. Do not save it all for special days.
Appreciation makes a plain meal taste like plenty.
When you are grateful for food, you waste less, enjoy more and rush less.
Eating is a daily miracle we have made routine. Notice it once today.
Being able to taste something delicious is a gift. Do not unwrap it in a hurry.
A glass of clean water is something a great many people would cross a desert for. Drink yours slowly.
Good food is one of the easiest ways to feel that today was a good day.
Let meals be the small celebration in an ordinary day.
Cooking is one of the oldest things people have ever done together. Take part in it.
Be thankful for the appetite that brings you to the table. It is a sign your body is still asking for life.
It is nice to remember, in the middle of a busy day, that you get to have lunch.
A shared meal is the oldest way of saying: you are welcome here.
Food connects us to our home, our people and our past. Eat it as if it matters.
Fresh fruit, a warm meal, clean water. You are richer than you think.
Savour the ordinary. The ordinary is where most of life is spent.
Some of life’s best moments happen over food. Eat well enough to be there for them.
Thank your body for the day it gave you, and then feed it for tomorrow.
Every meal is a chance to say yes to your own life.
Some days it is enough to have eaten something you enjoyed and something that was good for you. Occasionally it is the same thing.
Gratitude at the table makes the food taste better and the company feel warmer.
Nobody is too busy to be thankful for a hot meal. It only takes one breath.
Eating well is easier when you remember how lucky you are to be able to choose.
Every ingredient on your plate had a journey. Be a good end to it.
One good meal, eaten slowly and gladly, is a small holiday.
Say thanks before you eat. Even silently. Even quickly. It works anyway.
A bowl of something warm on a cold day is one of the great small joys of being alive.
It is a small miracle that a plate of plain food can change how a day feels.
Be glad of the ordinary meals. They are the ones that hold a life together.
The best meal of the week is often the one you had the time to enjoy.
Look around the table. This is the good part.
Gratitude is the quickest way to make a small meal feel like a feast.
